hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.emptyBody: Hosts you add appear here. Double-click one to open a Terminal.
hosts.newDescription: Keys in ssh-agent are tried first, then the private key file, then the password or the server's own questions (such as a one-time code). When asked for a password or passphrase, you can save it in the system keychain.
hosts.credentialsCleared: Saved credentials cleared. The next connect asks again.
hosts.terminalSchemeHint: Give production Hosts their own colours so they are hard to mistake.
hosts.defaultDirectoryHint: Where the File panel opens the first time. Leave blank for the home folder.
hosts.identitiesOnlyHint: When a key file is selected, offer only its matching key from ssh-agent and skip default key files.
hosts.forwardAgentHint: While connected, the remote host can use your SSH keys through your local agent. Reconnect to apply changes.
hosts.keepaliveHint: Leave blank to follow the global setting. Enter 0 to turn keepalives off. Reconnect to apply changes.
hosts.postLoginCommandHint: Runs once when each new shell is ready, including after reconnecting.

errors.keepaliveSeconds: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4,294,967,295

hosts.editDescription: Change how SSH Astra connects to this Host.
hosts.deleteHostBody: The Host is removed from the list. Terminals already open on it keep running.
hosts.deleteGroupBody: Its Hosts and Groups move up one level. Nothing inside is deleted.
hosts.noResultsBody: Try a different search or Tag filter.

import.title: Imported ~/.ssh/config
import.skipped: Skipped: a Host with this name already exists
import.proxyCommandHint: These commands run locally when you connect to the listed Hosts.

problems.jumpChainConflict: Its ProxyJump chain reaches {{hop}} differently from {{hop}}'s own settings
problems.jumpHostLoop: Its Jump hosts lead back to itself
problems.jumpHostUnavailable: Its Jump host {{hop}} was not imported

transfer.exported: Host list exported. Passwords and passphrases are never included.
transfer.imported: Import done. Hosts added: {{hosts}}. Groups added: {{groups}}.
transfer.skipped: Skipped because a Host with the same name exists: {{names}}.
transfer.exportFailed: Could not export the Host list: {{message}}

sftp.noHosts: Add a host to open an SFTP workspace.
sftp.localUnavailable: Open a local folder to download the file.
sftp.invalidName: This name is reserved or contains characters Windows does not allow.

tabs.renameHint: Clear the title to use the automatic name.

tabs.swapPaneDown: Swap pane with the pane below

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Open a Host, switch tabs or run an action.

files.title: Files
files.empty: Open a Terminal on a Host to browse its files here.
files.dockRight: Dock File panel on the right
files.dockBottom: Dock File panel at the bottom

search.limit: Search stopped after checking {{count, number}} entries. Results are incomplete.
search.skipped: Some folders could not be searched.

edit.title: Open in editor
edit.editing: Open in your editor. Saves upload automatically.
edit.noApplication: No application on this computer opens this file.
edit.notAFile: Only regular files open in the editor.

tooLarge.title: Too large to edit
tooLarge.body: {{name}} is larger than 10 MB, the most that opens in the editor. Download it instead?

binary.title: Not a text file
binary.body: {{name}} does not look like text. Editing it may damage it. Download it, or open it anyway?

errors.timedOut: The server did not answer in time.

files.name: Name

move.failures: Items that could not be moved

archive.compressDescription: The archive will be created in this folder with a .tar.gz extension.
archive.name: Archive name
archive.extractDescription: The contents will go into a new folder named “{{folder}}”.

nameProblem.dots: “{{name}}” cannot be used as a name.

delete.count_one: {{count}} item will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.count_other: {{count}} items will be deleted, including everything inside folders. This cannot be undone.

permissions.title: Permissions of “{{name}}”
permissions.ownershipHelp: Ownership applies to the selected item. Leave an ID blank to keep it.
permissions.directoriesOnly: Only add execute permissions to folders

operationErrors.ownershipUnavailable: The current owner or group ID is unavailable for {{path}}. Enter both IDs to change ownership.
operationErrors.archiveToolMissing: The required tool {{tool}} is missing on this Host.
operationErrors.archiveUnsupported: The archive format for “{{path}}” is unsupported.
operationErrors.archiveNotAFile: The archive is missing or is not a file.
operationErrors.archiveUnavailable: Archive operations require an SSH Connection.
operationErrors.archiveIncomplete: Extraction stopped. Partial contents may remain in “{{path}}”. {{message}}
operationErrors.moveIntoSelf: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
operationErrors.notOpen: The File panel is not connected.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.revealFailed: Could not show {{name}} in the file manager.

unprotected.label: Unprotected
unprotected.detail: An interruption can damage the original because the destination folder blocked temporary files.

conflict.title: This file already exists
conflict.body: A file with the same name is already at the destination. Replace it?

forwards.title: Port forwards
forwards.lead: Forward traffic through {{host}}'s Connection: reach its network from here, expose a port of this machine on it, or use it as a SOCKS proxy. A running Port forward keeps the Connection open, even with no Terminal.
forwards.emptyBody: Add a Port forward to reach a service behind this Host (such as a database), expose a local port on it, or browse through it as a SOCKS proxy.
forwards.forwardAgentHint: While connected, the remote host can use your SSH keys through your local agent. Reconnect to apply changes.
forwards.restartHint: Changes apply the next time it starts.
forwards.actionFailed: Could not save the Port forward: {{message}}

startErrors.portInUse: Port {{port}} on {{address}} is already in use. Choose another local port, or stop the program using it.
startErrors.permissionDenied: Not allowed to listen on port {{port}}. Ports below 1024 usually need administrator rights; choose a higher one.
startErrors.remoteRefused: The server would not listen on port {{port}} ({{address}}). It may be in use there, or the server's AllowTcpForwarding / GatewayPorts settings forbid it.

local.targetHost: As the Host sees it, for example localhost or db.internal.
local.bindAddress: Leave blank to accept connections from this machine only (127.0.0.1).

remote.targetHost: As this machine sees it, for example 127.0.0.1.
remote.bindAddress: Leave blank to accept connections from the Host itself only (localhost).

dynamic.bindAddress: Leave blank to accept connections from this machine only (127.0.0.1).

kindHints.local: A port on this machine that reaches an address on the Host's side (ssh -L).
kindHints.remote: A port on the Host that reaches an address on this machine's side (ssh -R).
kindHints.dynamic: A SOCKS5 proxy on this machine; the Host opens each connection (ssh -D).

forwards.autoStartHint: Runs whenever this Host connects: opening a Terminal, starting another Port forward, or Connect only.

sidebar.emptyBody: Open a Host's menu in the Host list, choose Port forwards, and add a rule. Hosts with rules are listed here with how many are running.

shellIntegration.disabled: Shell integration is off in Settings.
shellIntegration.unsupported: Shell integration is unavailable for this shell. Use bash 4.4+ with prompt expansion enabled, or zsh.
shellIntegration.timedOut: Shell integration is unavailable because the shell did not respond.

log.failed: Could not write the Terminal log. {{message}}

terminal.pressEnterToRestart: Press Enter to start a new shell.

paste.title: Paste {{count}} lines?
paste.body: The shell may run each line as soon as it arrives. Check the text before pasting.
paste.invisibleBody: Invisible characters can change how text appears or how the shell handles it. Check their Unicode codes in the preview before pasting.

proxy.jumpHint: This Connection uses the proxy setting of its first Jump host.
proxy.commandHint: Runs in your local shell when connecting. Use %h for the Host address, %p for the port, and %r for the username.
proxy.passwordHint: Optional. Add a username to enter a proxy password at connection time.
proxy.clearFailed: Could not clear the saved proxy password.

errors.proxyAddress: Enter a hostname or IP address.
errors.proxyUsername: Enter a username supported by this proxy type.

prompt.title: Proxy password for {{user}} at {{host}}
prompt.description: Enter the password for the outbound proxy.
prompt.label: Proxy password
prompt.retry: The proxy rejected the saved password.

hostKey.title: Unknown host key
hostKey.body: Check that this fingerprint belongs to {{host}} before trusting it.
hostKey.hint: Saving adds the key to ~/.ssh/known_hosts, shared with the ssh command. Temporary trust lasts until you quit SSH Astra.

password.title: Password for {{user}}@{{host}}
password.description: Used to sign in to this Host.
password.label: Password

mismatch.title: Host key has changed. Connection blocked
mismatch.body: {{host}} presented a different key than the one recorded. Someone may be intercepting the Connection, or the server was reinstalled.
mismatch.fix: If you are sure the change is legitimate, remove line {{line}} of {{path}} yourself, then connect again.
mismatch.fixForRun: If you verify the change is legitimate, restart SSH Astra and check the new fingerprint before trusting it.

errors.timedOut: The Host did not respond in time.
errors.hostKeyDeclined: The host key was not trusted. Not connected.
errors.hostKeyRevoked: The host key is revoked. Connection blocked.
errors.proxyInvalidTarget: The Host address is invalid for this proxy
errors.proxyUnreachable: Could not reach the outbound proxy
errors.proxyInvalidResponse: The outbound proxy returned an invalid response
errors.proxyConnectFailed: The outbound proxy could not connect to the Host
errors.proxyCommandTarget: A Host value contains characters that ProxyCommand cannot substitute
errors.proxyCommandFailed: The ProxyCommand closed the SSH connection
errors.keyUnreadable: Could not use the private key {{keyPath}}: {{reason}}
errors.keyPassphraseIncorrect: Wrong passphrase for the private key {{keyPath}}.
errors.keyRejected: The server rejected the private key {{keyPath}}.
errors.agentKeysRejected: The server rejected every key in ssh-agent.
errors.noSupportedMethod: No usable sign-in method. The server accepts: {{methods}}.

save.label: Save in the system keychain
save.unavailable: No system keychain is available, so this is asked for each time.

keyboardInteractive.title: {{user}}@{{host}} asks
keyboardInteractive.description: The server asks for more information to sign in.

lost.title: Disconnected
lost.newShell: Reconnecting starts a new shell; programs running before are gone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Changes apply right away and are kept after a restart.

shortcuts.description: Select a shortcut to record a new combination. Custom shortcuts replace the action’s default combinations.
shortcuts.shellCtrlLetter: Ctrl + letter combinations are reserved for the Terminal shell. Add another modifier.
shortcuts.missingModifier: Use a function key or add Ctrl, Alt, or the system modifier.
shortcuts.unsupportedKey: This key can’t be recorded. Try another key.
shortcuts.conflict: This shortcut is already used by {{action}}. Replacing it leaves conflicting actions unassigned.
shortcuts.resetConflict: A default shortcut is already used by {{action}}. Replacing it leaves conflicting actions unassigned.

actions.swapPaneUp: Swap pane with the pane above
actions.swapPaneDown: Swap pane with the pane below

confirmClose.label: Confirm Terminal close
confirmClose.description: Ask before closing a connected remote Terminal.

confirmQuit.label: Confirm app quit
confirmQuit.description: Ask before quitting while Connections, transfers, or Port forwards are active.

tabOrientation.label: Tab orientation
tabOrientation.description: Place tabs across the top or along the left side of the workspace.

groupTabsByHost.label: Group tabs by Host
groupTabsByHost.description: Show multiple tabs for the same Host in a collapsible group.

settings.groupTabsRequiresVertical: Choose Vertical under Tab orientation to use this setting.

restoreTabs.label: Restore tabs
restoreTabs.description: Choose what happens to your tabs and panes the next time SSH Astra starts.

follow.label: Follow system appearance
follow.description: Switch between a light and a dark theme with your computer's setting.

theme.usedWhenLight: Used when your computer is light
theme.usedWhenDark: Used when your computer is dark

interfaceFont.label: Interface font
interfaceFont.description: Enter a font name. An empty or unavailable font uses the system font.

language.label: Interface language
language.description: System uses your computer's language when SSH Astra has it, otherwise English.

font.label: Font
font.description: A CSS font list; the first font installed on this computer is used.

fontWeight.label: Font weight
fontWeight.description: Regular text weight from {{min}} to {{max}}. The default is 400.

lineHeight.label: Line height
lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font’s height, from {{min}} to {{max}}.

letterSpacing.label: Letter spacing
letterSpacing.description: Extra space between character cells, from {{min}} to {{max}} pixels.

ligatures.label: Ligatures
ligatures.description: Joins character pairs such as -> and != when the font supports it.

colorScheme.label: Colour scheme
colorScheme.description: Used by every Terminal unless its Host sets its own.

importedSchemes.label: Imported colour schemes
importedSchemes.description: Add an iTerm2 colour scheme for any Terminal or Host.
importedSchemes.invalid: This file is missing a valid iTerm2 colour palette.
importedSchemes.tooLarge: Choose an .itermcolors file no larger than {{max}} KiB.
importedSchemes.unreadable: Could not read this colour scheme file.

cursorStyle.label: Cursor shape
cursorStyle.description: Default shape of the Terminal cursor.

cursorBlink.label: Blink cursor
cursorBlink.description: Blink the Terminal cursor by default.

wordSeparator.label: Word separators
wordSeparator.description: Characters that split words when you double-click text. Clear the field to restore the defaults.

titleSource.label: Tab title source
titleSource.description: Use the shell title or the Host name. In Host mode, Local terminals use their default names. Custom tab names take priority.

bell.label: Terminal bell
bell.description: Choose what happens when a program rings the Terminal bell.

highlighting.label: Keyword highlighting

builtIn.label: Built-in rules
builtIn.description: Colour errors, warnings, failures, successes and IPv4 addresses.

highlighting.description: Add up to {{max}} custom rules. Patterns ignore case and later rules take priority.

copyOnSelect.label: Copy on select
copyOnSelect.description: Selecting text in a Terminal copies it to the clipboard.

autoLog.label: Automatically write Terminal logs
autoLog.description: Save plain-text output from every new local or remote Terminal.

logDirectory.label: Terminal output folder
logDirectory.description: Where new Terminal logs and Recordings are saved.
logDirectory.failed: Could not choose a Terminal output folder. {{message}}

rightClickPaste.label: Right-click paste
rightClickPaste.description: When on, right-clicking pastes the clipboard. When off, it opens the Terminal menu.

confirmMultilinePaste.label: Confirm multi-line paste
confirmMultilinePaste.description: Ask before pasting more than one line, since the shell runs each line as it arrives.

shellIntegration.label: Shell integration
shellIntegration.description: Remote bash and zsh Terminals opened from now on tell the File panel when you cd, so it follows. Turning it off stops every File panel following at once and types nothing into new shells; Sync to Terminal folder still works.

keepalive.label: Keepalive interval
keepalive.description: How often an idle Connection checks the server is still there. A dropped Connection is noticed after three missed checks. Applies to new Connections.

outboundProxy.label: Outbound proxy
outboundProxy.description: Routes the first TCP hop of new Connections. Hosts can override this choice.

agentPath.label: Custom agent path
agentPath.description: Enter a local Unix socket or Windows named pipe for SSH authentication and agent forwarding. Leave blank to use the system agent. Applies to new Connections.

concurrency.label: Simultaneous transfers
concurrency.description: How many uploads and downloads run at once; the rest wait their turn. A folder's files copy one after another.

transfers.label: Transfer batches
transfers.description: Notify when a group of uploads, downloads, or copies finishes in the background.

reconnect.label: Failed reconnections
reconnect.description: Notify when a dropped Connection cannot reconnect in the background.

longCommand.label: Long-running commands
longCommand.description: Notify when a long-running command finishes while the app is in the background. Requires Shell integration in a remote Terminal using bash 4.4+ with prompt expansion enabled, or zsh.
longCommand.shellIntegrationOff: Shell integration is off. Turn it on in Terminal settings and open a new remote Terminal to receive these notifications.

longCommandThreshold.label: Long-command threshold (seconds)
longCommandThreshold.description: Commands must run longer than this to trigger a notification. The default is {{seconds}} seconds.

terminal.label: Terminal programs
terminal.description: Allow programs in a Terminal to send a notification while the window is in the background.

diagnostics.logsDescription: View the application and crash logs on this computer.
diagnostics.reportDescription: Copy a report with Host and account details replaced by codes.
diagnostics.openFailed: Could not open the log folder.

version.label: Version
version.description: SSH Astra {{version}}. Updates come from the project's GitHub releases.

checkOnStartup.label: Check for updates on startup
checkOnStartup.description: When a newer version is out, the status bar offers to install it. Nothing is downloaded until you choose to.

updates.upToDate: SSH Astra is up to date
updates.noReleaseNotes: No release notes are available for this version.
updates.interruptions: Restarting will interrupt the following activity.

quit.title: Quit SSH Astra?
quit.interruptions: Quitting will interrupt the following activity.

quickConnect.saveAsHostDescription: Name this Host to add it to your Host list. Open Terminals and File panels stay connected.
quickConnect.noLongerAvailable: This Temporary Host is no longer available.
quickConnect.failed: Could not open a Temporary Host.

home.search: Search Hosts by name, address, user or Tag
home.emptyBody: Enter an SSH address above to connect, or add or import Hosts to open them again later.
